explanation: This is a recency-mixing head: its write is a weighted average of the head-values of the last ~5 tokens (mean attention 0.15 self, 0.21 previous, 0.17 two back, 0.12 three back, 0.08 four back, decaying to ~0.01 by lag 10) and, in a text's first four tokens only, of the opening token with 0.4-0.6 of the weight, so it leaves its mean write when that window holds a token with an atypical head-value: the same word is far more active after a bracket or a name than after 'the'. It is strongly active (0.6-1.0 of max, 3.3-5.5) at tokens 2-4 of any text whose first token is a bracket or a bracket-led token ('(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}', '（', '「', '『', '【', '“', '{{', '{%', '([', '[1]', '(a)', '[Update]', '(Note)'), inactive (0.10-0.20 of max, 0.57-1.16) for a text that opens with 'The' plus a common lowercase word and runs on as plain prose with no bracket, quote, digit or proper name, borderline (about half of all texts cross the line there) for any other opener, and past the first ~6 tokens it only grazes its line (0.2-0.35 of max) at a capitalised or rare token such as a surname after a given name.
